+    # The narrowly supported original profile has fully materialized fields.
+    # Reproduce Go struct field order, with only map-valued Tags sorted; do not
+    # claim to normalize arbitrary provider Plans or future schema versions.
+    def ordered(value, keys):
+        require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == set(keys.split()), 'prior_identity_mismatch')
+        return {k: value[k] for k in keys.split()}
+    p = ordered(plan, 'schema lease_id request_id provider region repository operator expires_at budget provenance network placement host_groups tags')
+    p['budget'] = ordered(p['budget'], 'currency limit_micros committed_micros operational_stop_micros')
+    p['provenance'] = ordered(p['provenance'], 'source_sha bundle_digest')
+    p['network'] = ordered(p['network'], 'isolated single_zone initial_access conservative_public_egress_bytes')

+        if group.get('public_ipv4') is True:
+            keys += ' peak_bandwidth_mbps'
+        g = ordered(group, keys)

+"""Reduce pre-clock streams to fixed non-secret fields and bounded digests."""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import signal
+import sys
+
+
+def reduce_stream(mode):
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    count = 0
+    prefix = bytearray()
+    complete = True
+    try:
+        while True:
+            chunk = sys.stdin.buffer.read(65536)
+            if not chunk:
+                break
+            digest.update(chunk)
+            count += len(chunk)
+            if mode == "state" and len(prefix) < 8192:
+                prefix.extend(chunk[:8192 - len(prefix)])
+    except TimeoutError:
+        complete = False
+    result = {"bytes": count, "sha256": digest.hexdigest(), "complete": complete}
+    if mode != "state":
+        return result
+    enums = {
+        "ActiveState": {"active", "reloading", "inactive", "failed", "activating", "deactivating", "maintenance", "refreshing"},
+        "LoadState": {"stub", "loaded", "not-found", "bad-setting", "error", "merged", "masked"},
+        "SubState": {"dead", "condition", "start-pre", "start", "start-post", "running", "exited", "reload", "reload-signal", "reload-notify", "stop", "stop-watchdog", "stop-sigterm", "stop-sigkill", "stop-post", "final-watchdog", "final-sigterm", "final-sigkill", "failed", "auto-restart", "auto-restart-queued", "cleaning"},
+        "Result": {"success", "resources", "protocol", "timeout", "exit-code", "signal", "core-dump", "watchdog", "start-limit-hit", "oom-kill", "exec-condition"},
+    }
+    numbers = {"Job": 4294967295, "ExecMainCode": 6, "ExecMainStatus": 255}
+    values = {}
+    invalid = set()
+    hashes = {}
+    unknown = False
+    for line in bytes(prefix).splitlines():
+        key, sep, value = line.partition(b"=")
+        try:
+            name = key.decode("ascii")
+        except UnicodeDecodeError:
+            unknown = True
+            continue
+        if not sep or name not in enums and name not in numbers:
+            unknown = True
+            continue
+        if name in hashes:
+            invalid.add(name)
+            values.pop(name, None)
+            continue
+        hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+        try:
+            text = value.decode("ascii")
+        except UnicodeDecodeError:
+            invalid.add(name)
+            continue

+            values[name] = text

+        else:
